question: What kind of qualified recipient, tested over the course of one year, is alone fit to receive a teaching that carries an obligation of transmission?
premises: The teaching carries a strict obligation to be given to a specific recipient.
That recipient must be one who has previously accomplished the required practice.
That recipient must have been tested for a full year before transmission.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person who has passed a year-long test.
uncertainties: The nature of the test itself is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given only to one who has previously accomplished the practice and has been tested for one year.
